title: 4/29 promoted bpm feature (per-group lambda) slowed the prediction cycle past the 5-min heartbeat threshold; Healthchecks failure DM
tier_reason: a latency regression that tripped the heartbeat monitor once and was fixed and redeployed 16 minutes after the deploy that caused it; no delivery impact attributable to the slowdown (the same deploy's inference crash is I-040)

contract.text: A scheduler prediction cycle keeps the RUNNING heartbeat under 5 minutes old; feature computation on the production frame finishes well inside that threshold.
contract.source: scripts/check_heartbeat.py RUNNING_MAX_AGE = 5 min; commit a512851 message body

mechanism.text: 7afee63 (PR #4) computed batter_pitcher_shrunk_hr in compute_all_features with groupby().transform(lambda s: s.cumsum().shift(1).fillna(0)); on the ~1.5M-PA production frame the per-group Python lambda made feature computation about 3x slower, pushing a cycle past the 5-min threshold

residual.text: BatterPitcherMatchupExperiment.modify_features keeps the slow lambda; per the body it early-returns when the column exists and runs only in batch audits.

watchdog.trigger: a RUNNING heartbeat older than 5 min, or a lineup-check prediction cycle whose journal start-to-finish exceeds its budget, reported with the cycle's stage timings
watchdog.recovery_assertion: the next prediction cycles complete inside the budget with a fresh heartbeat throughout

evidence.what: PR #4, deployed 17:24 ET, pushed compute_all_features past the 5-min heartbeat threshold: stale=True at 17:30:01 ET (330 s old), which fired a Healthchecks failure DM; the vectorised replacement is bit-exact and about 3x faster
deploy of head 053aae4 (merge of PR #4 = 7afee63) created 2026-04-29T21:24:24Z (17:24:24 ET), conclusion success
deploy of head 6a21c78 (merge of PR #5 = a512851) created 2026-04-29T21:40:53Z (17:40:53 ET), conclusion success; log unavailable_expired
run_and_pick was wrapped in heartbeat_watchdog but _run_shadow_prediction (which also computes features) was not, so a slow feature computation there leaves the heartbeat to age

notes: tier: prelim A; drafted B because the slowdown itself had no evidenced delivery or liveness effect and was fixed in 16 min - flip to A if the lead counts a tripped liveness monitor as a liveness failure
why the heartbeat aged despite 0830ef4's wrap is not stated in the body; ev4 (unwrapped shadow prediction, wrapped only by 150ed4c on 5/09) is a plausible path - my inference, not evidenced
this alert was genuine (the heartbeat really was 330 s old), so alert.attempted records it; receipt of the Healthchecks DM is not retained (O1)
E39 and I-040 share the root commit 7afee63 (same rollout) but are distinct mechanisms
no regression test in the fix (timing change only); the body cites a bit-exact check on 65k rows
